raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 26 txn_ids with a second record_version (4828 rows vs 4802 distinct txn_ids, with record_version=2 on 26 rows). silver_transactions only filters on status and never keeps just the latest version, so 25 txn_ids (the POSTED ones) are duplicated and double-counted in every gold table. The fix keeps the latest record_version per txn_id first and then applies the POSTED filter, so a transaction whose latest version is REVERSED is dropped.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
